messages:
marie: Heads up — the nightly cohort sweep that runs at 03:10 UTC is still causing short routing flaps for a subset of low-volume tenants. Saw 503 spikes for ~30s while the sweep job evicted old cohort entries. logs: `sweep: tenant=acct-92 evicted=12 rehash_ms=240`
aj: Can you paste the exact job command and timing? is this the same sweep we moved from 02:00 -> 03:10 last month?
marie: yep same job (cohort-sweeper v2). Command in k8s job: `kubectl exec -it cohort-sweeper -- ./sweep --window=48h --batch=500`
siva: iirc the issue is twofold: (1) eviction triggers a short KV-cache cold path that causes some requests to route to fallback pools, (2) our telemetry sampling for those tenants is 0.5% so we didn't get good traces to correlate.
ops-bot: scheduled-job cohort-sweeper v2 started at 2026-03-11T03:10:00Z (run-id=run-7290011200) :gear:
leo: quick numbers — in last 7 runs ~0.8% of tenants hit a routing fallback (mostly <100qps tenants). fallback latency bumped ~200ms for ~20s.
aj: could we spread the sweep instead of doing big batches? batch=500 seems aggressive. small batches over longer window would reduce local rehashing.
siva: agree. we also need a better sampling plan. propose adding a transient sampling override during sweep windows (e.g., bump tenants impacted to 20% traces for 5m) so we see the top stack traces.
marie: proposal: add a sweep-phase flag to runtime config with three knobs: `batch_size`, `stagger_window_ms`, `telemetry_sample_rate_override`. default keeps current behavior. rollout: dry-run -> canary (5%) -> 25% -> 100% across tenants over 48h.
leo: example config snippet: ```json
{"feature":"cohort_sweep_v2","batch_size":100,"stagger_window_ms":60000,"telemetry_sample_rate_override":0.2}
```
aj: love it. two safety asks: (A) make sweep jobs operate on a per-shard lease so only one pod touches a shard at a time, (B) auto-fallback to previous cohort snapshot if failure rate > 0.5% in a 1m window.
siva: can implement (A) quickly (redis locks). (B) needs a tiny control-plane hook to detect the signal and flip a config key. small API: `POST /admin/configs/revert?reason=sweep-fallback&run=run-7290011200`
marie: for rollout UX — add a console toggle under Debug -> Config Dry Run that shows affected tenant sample and estimated QPS impact. also show a heatmap of routing fallbacks when sweep is on vs off.
leo: i'll add a small dashboard panel (per-tenant heatmap + global rate) and an alert rule: if fallback_rate_pct > 0.4% for 2m during sweep-phase then notify #eng-oncall and pause the sweep.
aj: pause logic: when alert fires, set `cohort_sweep_v2.enabled=false` via the config API and post an incident note. ops-bot should also create a runbook entry.
ops-bot: created runbook note: "cohort-sweep pause -> revert snapshot -> re-run with smaller batch" (link: https://runbooks.local/r/729001)
marie: next steps: siva implement telemetry override endpoint + redis locking (ETA 1d), leo dashboard + alert (ETA 1d), aj add pause/revert API and canary rollout steps (ETA 2d). i'll drive the dry-run and coordinate ops. :+1:
aj: i'll own the canary rollout checklist and ops handoff.
siva: i'll post a PR with config schema and example, will tag y'all.
marie: thanks — want to avoid surprises during our next sweep. we'll dry-run this week in staging first. :eyes:
